intro: Four replies for you to post yourself. Posted = you published it under that post, Skip = leave it, Later = not now.

items.title: Reply under the ferry delay post
items.detail: They asked which morning sailings are still running.

copy.label: Copy reply
copy.text: The 08:10 and 09:40 are running. The 07:30 is cancelled.

items.title: Reply under the Saturday stall question
items.detail: A neighbour asked whether the bread stall is back this week.

copy.label: Copy reply
copy.text: Yes. The bread stall is in the usual spot from 9:00.

items.title: Reply under the late-opening post
items.detail: Someone asked if the reading room opens on Monday.

copy.label: Copy reply
copy.text: Monday opens at 12:00. The rest of the week is unchanged.

items.title: Reply under the new loaf post
items.detail: They want the price of the seeded loaf before they queue.

copy.label: Copy reply
copy.text: The seeded loaf is €3.80. We bake it until it sells out.
